entities.summary: Z11 Bernd von Arnim was a Type 1934A-class destroyer built for Nazi Germany's Kriegsmarine in the late 1930s. At the beginning of World War II, the ship was initially deployed to blockade the Polish coast, but she was quickly transferred to the German Bight to lay minefields in German waters. In late 1939 the ship made one successful minelaying sortie off the English coast that claimed one British warship and seven merchant ships. During the early stages of the Norwegian Campaign, Bernd von Arnim fought the British destroyer Glowworm while transporting troops to the Narvik area in early April 1940, but neither ship was damaged during the action.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: The Z11 Bernd von Arnim played a significant role in the early stages of World War II, contributing to the sinking of one British warship and seven merchant ships during a minelaying sortie off the English coast. Her actions were part of Germany's naval efforts to disrupt Allied shipping and supply lines.
